subject: Novaire trial: success criteria, metrics, and kickoff timeline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@novaire.ai>, Jenna Li <jenna.li@novaire.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Novaire - Trial criteria & next steps

Hi Samir / Jenna —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a concrete proposal for the 3-week trial we discussed so we can align on success criteria and responsibilities. Attaching a working evaluation plan (novaire-trial-eval-plan-2026-12-04.xlsx).

Summary of goals we heard from you:
- Replace existing retrieval + scoring pipeline for customer support suggestions (live routing to agents).
- Maintain or improve suggestion relevance/accuracy while lowering per-call inference cost.
- Be able to serve production traffic with <500ms 95th latency on typical queries.

Proposed measurable success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: p50 < 150 ms, p95 < 450 ms for 512-token max prompt when routed through standard infra (no warm caches counted).
2) Throughput: sustain 60 requests/sec (concurrent workload with typical batching profile) at target latency above.
3) Unit cost: average model cost <= $0.0008 per token on-hosted Redwood offering (including batching and prefix cache savings).
4) Quality / accuracy: automated evaluation on your seed prompt set >= 88% intent-level match and manual spot-check F1 >= 0.82 for entity extraction.
5) Hallucination ceiling: < 4% on our hallucination detection heuristics for the eval set.

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): exchange evaluation prompt set (seed + edge cases) and sample logs.
- Week 1: Redwood provisions trial model + integration sandbox; run synthetic load tests to calibrate batching and KV cache settings.
- Week 2: Run seeded evaluation (automated) and 100-manual spot checks; collect latency & cost telemetry.
- Week 3: Joint review, final acceptance decision and recommendation for next steps (Dedicated or Hosted conversion).

Ownership & next steps:
- Customer data & prompts: Novaire (Samir / Jenna) to deliver sample prompt set and 3 days of anonymized logs by Tuesday 12/8.
- Integration & instrumentation: Laura (AE) coordinate, Monica (CS) will run the seeded eval and manual spot checks.
- Cost baseline: Rishi (sales) to provide detailed unit-cost assumptions and options for reserved capacity if acceptance criteria met.

Please reply with any changes to the metrics above or the timeline. If you’re happy, we’ll schedule a kickoff next Monday (12/7) for 30 minutes and lock the deliverables.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- novaire-trial-eval-plan-2026-12-04.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB stub)
From: Samir Rao <samir@novaire.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna.li@novaire.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novaire - Trial criteria & next steps

Laura — thanks for the clear recap and draft targets. A couple quick clarifications before we lock things in: 

- For the latency numbers, does p95 include network + client-side processing or only the Redwood inference stack (i.e., from arrival at the model endpoint to token generation complete)? We want to ensure apples-to-apples with our existing telemetry.
- On unit cost: can you confirm whether $0.0008/token assumes a 1.5x token inflation for our longest prompts (we have a few very chatty examples)?
- For quality metrics: we can provide an intent taxonomy and a set of 2,000 labelled prompts but will need a quick template for labeling guidelines if manual spot checks are to be meaningful.

We're aligned on timeline broadly. Samir will send the anonymized logs by Monday 12/8; Jenna will send the labelled prompt taxonomy.

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Product | Novaire Inc.
samir@novaire.ai | +1 (415) 777-2233
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@novaire.ai>, Jenna Li <jenna.li@novaire.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novaire - Trial criteria & next steps

Samir / Jenna — quick answers and operational detail from CS side.

1) Latency scope: we will measure server-side inference time at the Redwood endpoint (time from request receive to last token emitted). We will provide a comparator script if you want to measure end-to-end from your client. For the trial acceptance, we recommend using server-side numbers to avoid noise from client network variance.

2) Token inflation: the $0.0008/token baseline assumes average tokenization after typical pre/post-processing. If your prompts regularly inflate tokens by 1.5x, cost estimate will reflect that; Rishi will include a scenario table.

3) Labeling template: attached is a short guideline file (novaire-acceptance-criteria-2026-12-05.md) with definitions for intent match, entity F1, and how to flag hallucinations. Monica will coordinate the manual spot-check pool (we recommend 100 random + 50 edge-case checks).

4) Instrumentation & telemetry: we will drop a lightweight agent in the sandbox to emit per-request latency, token counts, and model variant tags. Monica to own instrumentation + initial run.

Operational owners (agreed):
- Deliver prompt set & logs: Novaire (Samir / Jenna) — due 2026-12-08
- Sandbox provisioning + instrumentation: Redwood CS (Monica) — done by 2026-12-11
- Seeded evaluation + spot checks: Redwood CS (Monica) + Novaire SME (Jenna) — week of 2026-12-14
- Joint review & acceptance: Laura + Rishi + Novaire execs — 2026-12-21

If that looks right I’ll upload the labeling template now and we’ll wait for your logs.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0112

Attachment:

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@novaire.ai>, Jenna Li <jenna.li@novaire.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novaire - Trial criteria & next steps

Thanks everyone — this is a clean plan. A couple of commercial notes so we have alignment before kickoff: 

- Pricing note: the $0.0008/token target is achievable on Hosted with the default batching profile; if you want Reserved/Dedicated capacity with SLAs we can provide a committed pricing tier and separate SLOs (I’ll include two options in the formal quote).
- KPI gates for acceptance: we will require >=88% automated intent match AND either (a) p95 latency <450ms OR (b) agreement to a staged rollout with model variant fallback for higher-latency peaks. This gives Novaire flexibility if performance tuning yields trade-offs.

Action items:
- Laura: schedule 30m kickoff for 2026-12-07 11:00 PST — DONE (calendar invite sent).
- Novaire (Samir): upload anonymized logs + prompt taxonomy by 2026-12-08.
- Monica: sandbox + telemetry by 2026-12-11.
- Rishi: send formal quote + two capacity options by 2026-12-09 (HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/NV-2026-312).

Looking forward to kickoff — Laura will run the meeting and Monica will own the trial runs.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
